items.text: Lamar Jackson (left ankle) was limited Wednesday and practiced again Thursday, splitting first-team reps with Tyler Huntley; the Ravens' offensive coordinator said he 'still has a lot of work to do'. Game-time uncertainty: the model projects Huntley and shows a Jackson scenario.

Baltimore OLB Tavius Robinson (pectoral) did not practice Wednesday; WR Rashod Bateman and OTs Ronnie Stanley and Andrew Vorhees were limited. Cincinnati lists only S Kyle Dugger (quad, limited); Joe Burrow is not on the report.
